deaths.name: A person, maybe 60s, with weathered hand

sayLog.line: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.

The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Katarina blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
The village's quarrel was with Aria — and Aria is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.

Mabel looks away. "Something about a promise made at a funeral, broken by spring. Ask directly and the conversation ends." That's all you get. Maybe that's all there is.
That night, they bring Aria home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.

convos:
## lately-d24 after Amy's death — lately with Layla (d24)
> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "I'm not proud of how I survive. I'm just committed to it."

> YOU PICK [dlg:react] 
YOU: (listen)
NPC: "Well." A breath. "That's where things stand."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Go on."
NPC: "One more day. That's the goal. It's always been the goal. Everything else is decoration."

> YOU PICK [dlg:react] 
YOU: (listen)
NPC: "I do what the day requires. Some days that's ugly. I live with it."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "I’m listening."
NPC: "I'm harder than I was. I don't know if that's good. I know it's useful."

> YOU PICK [dlg:react] 
YOU: (listen)
NPC: "Survival isn't pretty. It's Tuesday. It's boring and relentless and I choose it."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "Keep going."
NPC: "I should get back to it."

> YOU PICK [silence] 
(conversation ended by the engine)

## lately-d24 after Aria's death — lately with Layla (d24)
> YOU PICK [dlg:details] 
YOU: "Tell me why you need this."
NPC: "It's getting worse, not better. If it festers I'm no good to anyone — can't haul, can't hunt, can't watch. Just clean it out and wrap it tight."

> YOU PICK [dlg:favor_requirements] 
YOU: Why can’t I do this now?
NPC: Move next to them, on the same side of the Haven door, to help.

> YOU PICK [dlg:commit] 
YOU: "I’ll come back to help."
NPC: "Careful with it. And — thank you."

> YOU PICK [dlg:favor_requirements] 
YOU: Why can’t I do this now?
NPC: As I said — Move next to them, on the same side of the Haven door, to help.

> YOU PICK [dlg:subject] 
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"
NPC: "Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"

> YOU PICK [alive:event:mourning] 
YOU: "How are you holding up? About... them."
NPC: "Aria is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."

> YOU PICK [dlg:invite] 
NPC: "Someone should watch your back. Might as well be me."
NPC: "Okay. We'll pick this up later."

> YOU PICK [silence] 
(conversation ended by the engine)

## lately-d28 after Hubert's death — lately with Layla (d28)
> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "And?"
NPC: Layla has an edge today — something curdled.

> YOU PICK [dlg:react] 
YOU: "Don't mention it."
NPC: "Good. Then we're square." They look lighter for it.

> YOU PICK [dlg:cant] 
YOU: "Don't worry about it."
NPC: "Okay. Your call." They file it away — unpaid, and counted.

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "And?"
NPC: "Come see what I found. You won't believe it."

> YOU PICK [betrayal:accept] 
YOU: "All right. Let's go."
NPC: On the way, Layla stops and actually teaches you something — how they read a slope for water, how their grandmother did it. (Knowledge, freely given. The Codex notes it.)

> YOU PICK [recap] 
YOU: "Wait — what were we talking about?"
NPC: "Still on that debt."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "And?"
NPC: They relax, a fraction. This is going well.

> YOU PICK [recap] 
YOU: "Wait — what were we talking about?"
NPC: "Still on that debt. That's still where we are."

## lately-d40 after Jorge's death — lately with Layla (d40)
> YOU PICK [dlg:comfort] 
YOU: "Hey — you alright?"
NPC: "Is that so? I — yeah. It helps, hearing that."

> YOU PICK [dlg:stay] 
YOU: "I'm not going anywhere."
NPC: They pat the ground beside them. "Here. It's dry."

> YOU PICK [dlg:empathize] 
YOU: "I'm here."
NPC: "My hands stopped shaking. That's — that's something. Thank you for sitting here."

> YOU PICK [recap] 
YOU: "Wait — what were we talking about?"
NPC: "Still on that hard time."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "You don't have to say it all at once."
NPC: Something eases in their shoulders. They're really talking to you now.

> YOU PICK [recap] 
YOU: "Wait — what were we talking about?"
NPC: "Interesting — Like I said — Still on that hard time."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "You don't have to say it all at once."
NPC: "Alright. Catch you later."

> YOU PICK [silence] 
(conversation ended by the engine)

## lately-d46 after Katarina's death — lately with Layla (d46)
> YOU PICK [dlg:details] 
YOU: "Tell me why you need this."
NPC: "It's been too long since a real meal. I can't pull my weight like this. Anything you can spare, I'll make it stretch."

> YOU PICK [dlg:favor_requirements] 
YOU: Why can’t I do this now?
NPC: They are no longer available to receive help.

> YOU PICK [dlg:commit] 
YOU: "I’ll come back to help."
NPC: "Thank you. I won't forget who fed me when it mattered."

> YOU PICK [dlg:favor_requirements] 
YOU: Why can’t I do this now?
NPC: As I said — They are no longer available to receive help.

> YOU PICK [dlg:subject] 
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"
NPC: "Forget I said anything. What did you want?"

> YOU PICK [alive:event:mourning] 
YOU: "How are you holding up? About... them."
NPC: "Last time things were different. They always are." "I dreamed Katarina was still here. Woke up angry at the dream. Stupid."

> YOU PICK [dlg:invite] 
YOU: "Want to come with me?"
NPC: "...Fine. This had better be worth it."

> YOU PICK [teach] 
NPC: You show them Ginger — where it grows, how to tell it apart. A short laugh. "And I've been walking past it for weeks."
NPC: "Anyway — I should get going."

YOU: "I need to ask you something."
NPC: "What? No — I mean —" Mabel stumbles. "It's... it's complicated. Can we not do this right now?"

> YOU PICK [dlg:invite] 
YOU: "Want to come with me?"
NPC: "...Sorry, lost my train of thought."

> YOU PICK [dlg:subject] 
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"
NPC: "...Anyway. Sorry. What's on your mind?"

> YOU PICK [party_name] 
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "I’m listening."

> YOU PICK [dlg:subject] 
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"
NPC: "Sorry — I got lost in it for a second. What did you want to ask?"

> YOU PICK [party_name] 
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"
NPC: "Sorry — I got lost in it for a second. What did you want to ask?"

> YOU PICK [dlg:react] 
YOU: (listen)
NPC: They nod slowly, not quite done, not quite continuing.

## lately-d88 after Elena's death — lately with Mabel (d88)
> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Go on."
NPC: "That's the whole of it. Sorry."

> YOU PICK [dlg:subject] 
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"
NPC: "...Anyway. What did you want to ask?"

> YOU PICK [confront:d_rknyee6] 
YOU: "You said something odd the other day. Let's talk about it."
NPC: "Never mind."

> YOU PICK [dlg:react] 
YOU: (listen)
NPC: "Anyway." A small smile.

> YOU PICK [dlg:doubt] 
YOU: "That doesn't quite add up."
NPC: "...What's that supposed to mean?" Their voice goes careful.

> YOU PICK [recap] 
YOU: "Wait — what were we talking about?"
NPC: "Still on their secret."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "Please, go on."
NPC: "I should go. Before I overthink this conversation too."

> YOU PICK [silence]
